blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police in Carrascal, Surigao del Sur, have launched a deeper investigation into the death of a vocal pro-Duterte vlogger on Sunday morning. The victim, Philip Morales Engbino, 48, a married native of Minglanilla, Cebu, was also the manager of EZMMI GenCon, a major contractor for Strong Group Mining Corp. (SGMC). Engbino was driving a company-owned white Dongfeng pickup vehicle when unidentified assailants ambushed and shot him at around 6 a.m. READ: Pro-Duterte vlogger shot dead in Surigao del Sur – reports Maj.
